correctness.rationale: Independently constructed Petersen P=KG(5,2) (10 vertices,15 edges) and its weight-three reduced Świątkowski differential, chain ranks (680,2400,2700,960); checked every ∂² column is zero. Independently computed complete boundary ranks (679,1715,960) over F3 and F5. First/third rational ranks attain these via augmentation/domain upper bounds; 12 pentagon cycles in P span 6-dimensional graph H1 and can each be traversed with two particles parked outside, forcing H1 configuration dimension≥6 and thus rational rank ∂2≤1715; hence Betti vector (1,6,25,0). Independently computed all 120 natural S5 signed Euler supertraces via edge-orbit and half-edge local factors, then H1≅H1(P) to obtain χ2=(25,-3,1,-2,0,1,0) on seven conjugacy types. Independently implemented exact Murnaghan–Nakayama rim-hook characters and rational class-inner products, obtaining Specht multiplicities 1×(3,2),1×(3,1,1),2×(2,2,1),1×(2,1,1,1), all other partitions zero; dimension25, invariant subspace zero. Uses the genuinely functorial reduced Świątkowski model; modular ranks alone not elevated to Q equality without upper bounds.
